tomato___healthy: La ca chua hien tai khoe. Duy tri tuoi deu, tranh tuoi len la vao chieu toi va theo doi dinh ky.
tomato___early_blight: Cat bo la bi dom som, giu tan la thong thoang, co the phun che pham goc dong theo huong dan su dung.
tomato___late_blight: Cach ly la benh nang, giam do am vung la, kiem tra cay lan can. Can can nhac thuoc dac tri theo khuyen cao dia phuong.
tomato___leaf_mold: Tang thong gio nha luoi, tranh do am cao keo dai, cat bo la benh va theo doi 2-3 ngay.
potato___healthy: La khoai tay dang khoe. Duy tri tuoi vua du va kiem tra sau benh moi 2-3 ngay.
potato___early_blight: Loai bo la bi benh, bo sung dinh duong can doi, han che tuoi phun vao la va theo doi sat.
potato___late_blight: Can xu ly som: cat la bi hai, tranh lan benh sang cay khac, can nhac bien phap phong tri theo huong dan chuyen mon.
pepper___healthy: La ot dang khoe. Tiep tuc cham soc va giu vuon thong thoang.
pepper___bacterial_spot: Cat la co vet benh, tranh tuoi len la, khu trung dung cu cat tia va theo doi trieu chung moi ngay.
